mapper.select: select s.snapshot_id, s.order_item_id, s.product_name, s.sku_code, s.attributes_json, s.image_url, s.origin_country_code, s.hs_code, s.declared_name, s.declared_value_amount, s.declared_currency_code, s.unit_price_amount, s.currency_code, s.create_time from order_item_snapshots s inner join order_items i on i.order_item_id = s.order_item_id where i.order_id = #{orderId} order by s.snapshot_id
mapper.insert: insert into order_item_snapshots (order_item_id, product_name, sku_code, attributes_json, image_url, origin_country_code, hs_code, declared_name, declared_value_amount, declared_currency_code, unit_price_amount, currency_code, create_time) values (#{orderItemId}, #{productName}, #{skuCode}, #{attributesJson}, #{imageUrl}, #{originCountryCode}, #{hsCode}, #{declaredName}, #{declaredValueAmount}, #{declaredCurrencyCode}, #{unitPriceAmount}, #{currencyCode}, sysdate())
